obfuscation_indicators: forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantitative detail on customer concentration, liquidity, covenants, inventory practices, and financing, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and broad, non-specific risk categories. Key risks include customer concentration, cancellation-related inventory impairment, fixed-cost operating leverage, covenant restrictions, inflation, and dependence on future design wins.
